description: This file implements the CatalogItemService class, which provides methods for managing catalog items via HTTP requests and data lookups within the eShopOnWeb application. It includes functionalities such as creating, editing, deleting, retrieving by ID, and listing catalog items with support for paging.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Service class responsible for CRUD operations and lookup of catalog items in the eShopOnWeb application.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item by sending a POST request with the item data.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item via a PUT request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item identified by its ID.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a single catalog item by its ID, including lookup of brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, with lookup of brand and type names.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the full list of catalog items, with lookup of brand and type names.
